connector.name: MemoraEU by pquattro (pquattro-memoraeu-mcp)
connector.registryDescription: Zero-knowledge persistent memory for Claude - encrypted, semantic search, EU hosted.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package memoraeu-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pquattro account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MEMORAEU_API_KEY
env.description: Your MemoraEU API key (starts with meu-sk-). Create one at app.memoraeu.isquarecube.fr.

env.name: MEMORAEU_SECRET
env.description: Your encryption secret (never sent to the server). Found in Settings on app.memoraeu.isquarecube.fr.

env.name: MEMORAEU_SALT
env.description: Your encryption salt. Found in Settings on app.memoraeu.isquarecube.fr.

env.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
env.description: Mistral API key for semantic embeddings. Get one at console.mistral.ai.
